[[File:M38ExplorerDroid3-FF59.png|thumb|right|250px|An M38-series explorer droid]]
An '''explorer droid''' or '''exploration droid''' was a [[Class two droid/Legends|class two droid]] designed to investigate new [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. They were assigned to [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessels]]. They were often equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] units and advanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Exploration droids were one of the main subcategories of second-degree droids, along with [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], [[environmental droid]]s, [[Engineering droid/Legends|engineering droids]], and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|sophisticated repair droids]]. One model of exploration droid was the [[M38-series explorer droid]] manufactured by [[LesTech]].
